entities.summary: The Páva Street Synagogue is a former Neolog Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at Páva u. 39 in Budapest, Hungary. Completed in 1924, the building was used a synagogue until World War II. The building was extensively renovated from 1999 and was repurposed to house the Holocaust Memorial Center since 2004.
